notes: GeoTalk 3.2.0: FIXED — internet call audio: both phones now confirm voice is flowing both ways, and if a direct connection cannot carry voice, both sides switch to Push-to-Talk together (no more silent calls). FIXED — you can place a new call right after a call ends; call ending is now reliably delivered and stale calls are cleaned up automatically. The call screen also shows live sent/received counters so any problem is visible. Random Chat, voice messages, free live internet + Bluetooth voice calls and in-app updates included.
